public_definitions: Review the public demographic planning dashboard, compare the 2012 population for 0-19 years and 20-39 years, then open the age-cohort planning follow-up record for the cohort with the larger 2012 population.
Use the public demographic planning dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2012 age-cohort population is larger.
Primary field label: '2012 larger-population age-cohort planning record'.
uncertain: The exact 2012 population values for '0-19 years' and '20-39 years' are not printed on the chart, so their relative sizes must be inferred from the visual positions of the data points at the 2012 mark on the x-axis.
